# GitHub Copilot - AF-DELIVERY-1.0

Use `docs/engineering/delivery-workflow.md` as the canonical workflow. Follow root `AGENTS.md`, `docs/PRODUCT_BOUNDARY.md`, `docs/engineering/ci.md`, the complete Jira issue and dependency links, and applicable scoped instructions. Investigate current `origin/develop` before editing, map acceptance criteria to tests, distinguish live, mocked, manual, and unverified evidence, and require a named human evidence owner. Never recommend Done from a merge badge alone.
